title: The Fed Doesn't Print Money To Change Interest Rates. Here's What It Actually Does.
description:
Educational purposes only. Not financial advice.

The Federal Reserve sets a target range for the federal funds rate, then uses tools like the interest it pays banks on reserves to pull the real rate toward that target. No printing press involved. That single rate ripples out into mortgages, credit cards, savings accounts and business loans across the entire US economy. Educational content only, not financial advice.
